notes: The mixed marquee for the See us in action beat. ORDER RULE, and it is deliberate: it OPENS ON A VIDEO, then alternates image, video, image so the eye keeps changing gear; when the videos run out the tail continues in images rather than looping the clips, because a repeat reads as a loop and a new photograph reads as more evidence. Stills are chosen for a clinic owner (the finished operatory, the fit, the handover, where it is taught) and are deliberately different from the team-fun strip.
